newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's CIB gets $200 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's CIB gets $200 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Commercial International Bank of Egypt (CIB) has signed a three-year syndicated loan at LIBOR plus 40 basis points for $200 million, double the amount it originally sought, banking sources said on Sunday.
"The bank was offered loans worth $350 million to $400 million but they settled for $200 million," a source said.
Chase Investment Bank Ltd and Union Bank of Switzerland arranged the syndicated loan, the sources said. ING Barings and Commerzbank were joint lead arrangers.

CIB, Egypt's largest private sector bank and the only one with shares traded internationally, has issued domestic Egyptian pound floating rate notes and is also considering the issue of Eurodebt securities towards the end of the year.
